en: Alerts now come in three strengths: Normal, Ring (vibrate, sound or both) and Forced.
A Forced alert rings at full alarm volume until you answer a simple question, then puts your volume back.
After an update Tentacle shows what changed; the new “What's new” button lists everything since your previous version.
zh: 提醒分为三级：普通提醒、响铃提醒（可选震动、响铃或两者）和强制提醒。
强制提醒以闹钟最大音量响起，答对一道简单的题才能关掉，关掉后恢复原来的音量。
更新后会显示更新内容；新增的“更新内容”按钮可查看自上个版本以来的所有变化。

en: The Wi-Fi line on the main screen no longer suggests your computer is connected when it only shows the phone's own address.
zh: 主界面的 Wi-Fi 一行只显示手机自己的地址，不再让人误以为电脑已经连上。

en: Optional: share your phone's notifications with your computer. Payment messages are hidden.
zh: 可选：把手机通知共享给电脑。支付类消息会被隐藏。

en: Fixed: “Check for updates” did not work in some installed versions.
zh: 修复：部分版本中“检查更新”无法使用的问题。

en: Your requests from the app are reviewed before they are released, and a failed request can be tried again.
zh: 你在应用里提的需求会先经过审核再发布；失败的需求可以重试。

en: The main screen is simpler, with sections you can expand when you need them.
zh: 主界面更简洁，各个栏目可以按需展开。

en: Alarm-style alerts no longer play their sound twice.
zh: 像闹钟一样的提醒不再重复响两遍。

en: Your computer can send you notifications, or an alarm-style alert if you allow it.
zh: 电脑可以给你发通知；如果你允许，还能发像闹钟一样的提醒。

en: Optional: pass SMS verification codes to your computer. Payment codes are never passed on.
zh: 可选：把短信验证码转给电脑。支付类验证码绝不转发。

en: When an update is available the button becomes “Update now”, and the app asks only once per new version.
zh: 有新版本时按钮变成“立即更新”，每个新版本只询问一次。

en: Send requests and problem reports to your computer from the app; your computer can fix them and publish an update.
The app keeps a log you can view or attach to a problem report.
zh: 可以在应用里给电脑提需求、报问题，电脑处理后会发布更新。
应用会记录日志，可以查看，也可以附在问题报告里。

en: The connection through your own server stays steadier when the network changes.
zh: 网络切换时，通过自己服务器的连接更稳定。

en: The download is less than half the size.
zh: 安装包缩小了一半多。

en: Pasted server details are recognized more reliably.
zh: 粘贴的服务器信息识别得更准确。

en: A simpler, redesigned main screen.
Paste your server details and the app fills in the settings for you.
zh: 主界面重新设计，更简单易懂。
粘贴服务器信息，应用会自动识别并填好设置。

en: On the same Wi-Fi, your computer automatically uses the faster direct connection.
zh: 手机和电脑在同一个 Wi-Fi 时，自动使用更快的直连。

en: Built-in Tailscale: reach your phone from anywhere, even while a VPN or proxy app is on.
zh: 内置 Tailscale：即使开着 VPN 或代理应用，也能从任何地方连上手机。

en: New name: Tentacle.
Reach your phone from outside your home network through your own server.
Updates can be installed from inside the app, and the app speaks English and Chinese.
zh: 改名为 Tentacle。
可以通过你自己的服务器，在外面也能连上手机。
可以在应用内安装更新，界面支持中文和英文。

en: First version: your own computer can browse the files on your phone over the local network.
zh: 第一个版本：你自己的电脑可以通过局域网浏览手机上的文件。
